tasks.title: Docs: close the reviewer-containment drift in README and CLAUDE.md, then document round-18's changes
tasks.description:
Two jobs: finish what round 17's docs task (#123) left, then document what round 18 shipped.

PART A — the drift #123 missed (see .cairn/reviews/round-17.md, '## Task #123' > 'Gaps', and '## Task #118' > 'Regression Risks' 1 and 3).

1. README ~line 164 ('Headless `cairn run` agents are constrained by their prompts and (for the reviewer) a scoped `--allowedTools` list'). `--disallowedTools` does not appear in README AT ALL, so a reader of README alone still concludes the `git diff --output=<file>` hole is open — it was closed for the headless path in #121. #123 was scoped to '~line 167' and correctly fixed that line; this is its counterpart and was missed. One clause closes it.
2. CLAUDE.md enforcement point 2 (around line 142) likewise still describes the reviewer's headless containment purely in `--allowedTools` terms. Not wrong, and line ~177 now carries the full story, but the two should not read as contradicting each other.
3. CLAUDE.md's 'Remaining headless gap' paragraph: the accepted-gap note is now INCOMPLETE rather than wrong. It calls out `--output` but not the `--output${X}=f` shell-expansion variant, which is what the shipped `Bash(*$*)` deny actually covers.
4. Check BOTH files for any remaining claim that the reviewer's Bash is denied only on 'redirection (`<`, `>`), backticks, or `$(`'. #118 widened that to ANY `$` anywhere. CLAUDE.md was updated in #123; verify README says the same thing.
5. Add one line noting that re-running `cairn init` can now APPEND to an existing `.cairn/.gitignore` (#117's behaviour) — a new class of side effect for `init` that is currently undocumented, and which users should know about before they re-run it.

PART B — round-18 changes. Document what actually landed in this round, reading each commit rather than trusting these descriptions:
- the round-done temp-file sweep and exactly which files it does and does not remove (the never-sweep list is the load-bearing half);
- `cairn init`'s gitignore merge: continues on an unreadable file, and honours a `!` negation;
- the hook's split between decision resolution and error-log destination, and WHY the 'same resolver' invariant was relaxed;
- `tsconfig.json`'s `noEmit`, with the reason (a bare `tsc` would otherwise emit into `dist/` next to the binary).

RULES. Docs-only: no `src/`, `test/`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` or `cairn.json` changes. Verify every claim against the code that shipped before you write it — CLAUDE.md records a real incident caused by a stale claim in that file, and two separate round-17 findings are docs drift, so this is the failure mode this repo actually has. Do NOT restore `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` or touch `install.sh`: both are user-managed for the round (CLAUDE.md, pin/unpin section).
tasks.notes:
# Task #137 completion notes

Docs-only task, two parts. Verified every claim against the actually-shipped code (grep'd `src/`, read the round-18 commits `f4ec1a4`, `49f8144`, `d46ab41`, `e088a76`, `4610bc0`) before writing anything, per the task's own warning about docs drift.

## Part A — round-17 drift (#123 gaps)

Found that CLAUDE.md items 2, 3, and 4 were **already fixed on disk** (not by this task) — the file's live content already has the "Headless reviewer containment" paragraph (with `--disallowedTools`/`REVIEWER_DISALLOWED_BASH_RULES` fully explained) and the hook bullet already says "a `$` anywhere," not the old "redirection/backticks/`$(`" phrasing. README's hook bullet (line ~167) already had the same "`$` anywhere" wording too. So the only real gaps were:

1. **README line 164** — added a clause: the reviewer's headless containment is "a scoped `--allowedTools` list plus a `--disallowedTools` denylist that closes the one hole an allow-prefix rule can't exclude — `git diff --output=<file>` and its `$`/quote-splitting variants." Previously README never mentioned `--disallowedTools` at all, so a README-only reader would have wrongly concluded the hole was still open for the headless path.
2. **CLAUDE.md enforcement point 2** (~line 142) — appended a pointer sentence to "Headless reviewer containment" below, so the `--allowedTools`-only framing there doesn't read as contradicting the fuller story.
3. Item 5 (gitignore-append mention) was **already present** in README (added by #123) — no change needed there, but see Part B below for the two *new* gitignore-merge behaviors round 18 actually shipped (negation + continue-on-error), which were genuinely undocumented and which I added to both files.

## Part B — round-18 changes documented

- **Round-done temp-file sweep** (`sweepRoundTempFiles`, `src/temp-sweep.ts`, task #131): added a bullet to CLAUDE.md's "Run state" section and a paragraph to README's "Run state" section. Both spell out the full never-sweep list (`tasks.json`, `tasks.completed.json`, `state.json`, `.gitignore`, `planning-notes.md`, `reviews/`, plus the still-live `.cairn_run_state.json`/`.cairn_iterations.log`/`.cairn_hook_errors.log`) as the load-bearing half, matching `src/temp-sweep.ts`'s own comment.
- **`cairn init` gitignore merge** (task #132): added to both files that a re-run (a) skips an entry the user has un-ignored with `!` rather than re-adding it, and (b) reports on stderr and lets the rest of init continue rather than aborting if the `.gitignore` can't be read. Verified against `mergeGitignoreEntries`/`initCoreFiles` in `src/commands/init.ts`.
- **Hook's decision/error-log resolver split** (task #133): verified CLAUDE.md's existing "hook resolves the project..." paragraph (line ~173) already accurately describes `resolveHookErrorLogDir` and the "why" (a hook that silently stopped containing anything would otherwise look identical to a healthy one) — no change needed, it was already correct and complete.
- **`tsconfig.json`'s `noEmit`** (task #135): CLAUDE.md's typecheck paragraph only covered `rootDir`/`include`; added the `noEmit: true` (replacing former `outDir: "dist"`) reasoning — a bare `tsc` (not just `tsc --noEmit`) would otherwise emit `dist/src/**`/`dist/test/**` into the same directory as the `dist/cairn` binary `install.sh` symlinks onto PATH. Not added to README — it's a dev-internal build detail README doesn't otherwise cover (README has no typecheck/tsconfig section at all).

## Verification

- `bun run typecheck` — clean.
- `bun test` — 1234 pass, 0 fail.
- `git status` confirms only `README.md`/`CLAUDE.md` touched by this task (the `cairn.json` and `.cairn/*` diffs pre-date this task — round-pinned `healthCheck`, left untouched per CLAUDE.md's pin/unpin section).

CANARY-17
